title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.05378v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-horizon agentic LLMs are increasingly limited by finite context windows, as extended interaction trajectories can exceed the maximum context length before a task is completed. Context compaction offers a natural solution by summarizing previous interaction states and continuing the rollout under a compressed context, but incorporating compaction into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. We propose CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning strategy to train long-horizon agentic LLMs with context compaction. Our approach jointly optimizes task execution and summary generation with token-level loss normalization and cross-segment generalized advantage estimation. This design enables the LLM agents to learn from compacted long-horizon trajectories. We train CompactionRL on top of open models and observe consistent performance gains on agentic coding tasks. translated_title: CompactionRL：面向长程智能体的上下文压缩强化学习
translated_abstract: 长程智能体大语言模型（LLM）日益受到有限上下文窗口的制约，因为延长的交互轨迹可能在任务完成之前就超出最大上下文长度。上下文压缩（context compaction）提供了一种自然的解决方案，即对先前的交互状态进行总结，并在压缩后的上下文中继续执行任务；然而，如何将压缩机制融入强化学习仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了 CompactionRL，这是一种结合上下文压缩来训练长程智能体 LLM 的强化学习策略。我们的方法通过词元级损失归一化（token-level loss normalization）和跨段广义优势估计（cross-segment generalized advantage estimation），联合优化任务执行与摘要生成。这一设计使 LLM 智能体能够从压缩后的长程轨迹中学习。我们在开源模型之上训练了 CompactionRL，并在智能体编程任务上观察到持续的性能提升。CompactionRL 使开源的 GLM-4.5-Air 模型（106B-A12B）能够达到……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 CompactionRL，通过词元级损失归一化和跨段广义优势估计，将任务执行与摘要生成进行联合强化学习优化，使长程智能体 LLM 能够从压缩后的长程轨迹中学习，并在智能体编程任务上取得持续的性能提升。
en_tdlr: CompactionRL is a reinforcement learning strategy that jointly optimizes task execution and summary generation via token-level loss normalization and cross-segment generalized advantage estimation, enabling long-horizon LLM agents to learn from compacted trajectories and achieve consistent gains on agentic coding tasks.
